questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 17 cm and a height of 6 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 17 × 6 = 51 cm².

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: In Lord of the Flies, what does the conch shell mainly symbolise?

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What type of white blood cell produces antibodies against a specific pathogen?

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Put these stages of the Munich Putsch in order
sequence: Hitler declares a revolution in a beer hall
Police open fire on the marchers
Hitler is arrested and put on trial
questions.why: The putsch began with Hitler's beer hall declaration, moved to a street march, was stopped by police gunfire, and ended with Hitler's arrest and trial.
